mapper.select: SELECT USER_NUM, EMAIL, PASSWD, USER_NAME, REAL_NAME, PHONE, BIRTH, INTRO, AUTH, LOGIN_TYPE, GOOGLE_ID, STATUS, REG_DATE, MODIFY_DATE FROM USERS WHERE USER_NUM = #{userNum}
SELECT USER_NUM, EMAIL, PASSWD, USER_NAME, REAL_NAME, PHONE, BIRTH, INTRO, AUTH, LOGIN_TYPE, GOOGLE_ID, STATUS, REG_DATE, MODIFY_DATE FROM USERS WHERE LOWER(EMAIL) = #{email}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USERS WHERE PHONE = #{phone} AND STATUS != 3
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USERS ( USER_NUM, EMAIL, PASSWD, USER_NAME, REAL_NAME, PHONE, BIRTH, INTRO, AUTH, LOGIN_TYPE, STATUS, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( SEQ_USERS.NEXTVAL, #{email}, #{passwd}, #{user_name}, #{real_name}, #{phone}, #{birth}, #{intro}, #{auth}, #{login_type}, #{status}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE USERS SET USER_NAME = #{user_name}, PHONE = #{phone}, INTRO = #{intro}, MODIFY_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE USER_NUM = #{user_num} AND STATUS != 3
UPDATE USERS SET PASSWD = #{passwd}, MODIFY_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE LOWER(EMAIL) = #{email}
